title: Tag
description: Draft 1, 2026-10-18. His calls: area is a tag built from a centre; kinds are user-made and compact over time by closeness in meaning. Proposal (not ruled): both are a centre plus a reach, in map-space or meaning-space, and compaction merges centres that sit inside each other's reach.

aliases.description: Names absorbed by merges and spelling variants. Variants are kept, never corrected.

centre.description: area: a point on the map. kind: a vector in meaning-space (embedding of the name, later of the events that carry it).

vector_ref.description: Key into the vector store; vectors are not kept inline.

reach.description: area: kilometres. kind: a distance threshold in the embedding's own metric (DormSoup had none; this is the fix).

merged_into.description: Calagator's duplicate_of trail: a merged tag keeps its row and points at the survivor.

merge_state.description: Proposal: the system suggests, a person confirms.
